    Linux 5.14 brought a new system call <code>memfd_secret</code> in order to mitigate speculative attack by preventing the kernel from being able to peek at these memory segments. Let’s use this syscall from the JVM with the <sub>~JEP-419</sub>~ JEP-454 API.
